The lever: anchor on blended CAC and treat platform ROAS as a directional gauge, not a verdict.

Caveat: blended CAC blurs new vs returning, so watch new-customer count specifically, not total orders, or repeat buyers will flatter your math. And the CTR genuinely doesn't matter here — it's downstream noise compared to this.
